references.text: Here it refers to the greatest commandment, also mentioned in Deuteronomy, about loving the Lord your God with all your heart, all your soul, and all your strength
This verse in the book of Psalms emphasizes the importance of loving the Lord, which aligns with what Jesus describes as the greatest commandment
Although this verse focuses on loving your neighbor, it is related to what Jesus says about the greatest commandment because it follows directly after and is inseparably linked to the love of God
